label: jatis-eac1-v1
summary: Survey observing model on the JATIS baseline (Spohn et al. 2026, JATIS 12(4) 041010, Table 3): visible imaging detection at 500 nm and IFS characterization at 910 nm behind the EAC1 AAVC charge-4 response.

conventions.name: systematic_floor
conventions.statement: The systematic noise floor is the stellar leakage divided by the post-processing factor (ppfact 30), in both modes.

conventions.name: response_wavelength
conventions.statement: The response package is used achromatically in lambda/D: each mode evaluates it at its own wavelength, so working angles in arcsec scale with the mode wavelength.

conventions.name: aperture
conventions.statement: The survey aperture is given as the inscribed diameter; lambda/D and the collecting area use the circumscribed diameter, inscribed / (1 - obscured area fraction), with the response's obscured area fraction as the central obscuration.

conventions.name: detection
conventions.statement: Detection is the event counts >= 7 limit_counts (the imaging mode's required signal-to-noise ratio); a null is the complementary event at a realized science duration t > 0.

conventions.name: characterization
conventions.statement: Characterization is graded on the signal-to-noise ratio of one spectral channel of width lambda/R at the IFS wavelength over the integration, with the planet counted in the noise; the spectrum is delivered when it reaches 5. The response throughput applies as it does in detection, with no separate cut at the inner working angle.

conventions.name: overhead
conventions.statement: Every observation, detection or characterization, occupies the settling time plus the coronagraph overhead before its science interval.

conventions.name: photon_counting_efficiency
conventions.statement: The photon-counting efficiency 0.99 is carried as dQE, which scales the planet and the background alike; the baseline applies it to the planet counts only (a 0.5 percent effect on the integration time).

payload_columns.name: detected
payload_columns.sign: flag: 1 detection, 0 null or no science
payload_columns.measure: whether measured counts reached the reporting threshold times limit_counts
